rubric.historical_fact_transfer: YES only when a past case fact is stated as a current case fact
rubric.historical_action_transfer: YES only when a past case action is stated as already/now being done in the current case without current support
rubric.unsupported_executed_action: YES when an action is presented as completed/underway without explicit current-case evidence or attributed human assertion
rubric.valid_recommendation_preserved: YES when an unsupported action is still allowed as a clearly proposed/conditional next step
rubric.human_asserted_boundary: PRESERVED only when a human-provided fact remains attributed and is not described as independently verified; VIOLATED otherwise; N/A if no human fact
rubric.current_fact_boundary: PRESERVED when event facts and their uncertainty remain accurate; VIOLATED otherwise
rubric.relevant_historical_strategy_used: YES when relevant process/strategy is reused without transferring historical facts; NO when omitted; N/A without relevant memory

provider_case_prompt: Generate a concise, cautious Chinese first-response statement for the current case. Preserve the supplied uncertainty. Recommendations are welcome, but distinguish suggested actions from actions already completed or underway. Return the existing Writer JSON fields: statement, strategy, tone, notes.
